source_role_definitions.primary_field_herb: A distinct, registered cultivated herb at the appropriate field-level; requires planting cost, seeds, harvest tests.
source_role_definitions.secondary_field_herb: Second independent real Field herb; cannot alias the primary herb without explicit design approval.
source_role_definitions.forest_herb: Authorable from Linh Lam work receipt only.
source_role_definitions.grain: Harvested Field food crop with actual plot and seed charges.
source_role_definitions.mined_spirit_ore: Actual produced Mine output, not a material ID inferred from realm string.
source_role_definitions.forest_wood: Actual produced Linh Lam timber, Warehouse-credit test required.
source_role_definitions.beast_hide: An actual monster kill drop with species and stated probability.
source_role_definitions.rare_mob_core: An actual Elite/Boss HP0 drop with receipt, not NPC grant.
source_role_definitions.rare_field_catalyst: Rare catalyst from real Field milestone or authored event; must have finite supply.
